verify_notes: Officially designated natural monument (GDOS register id PL.ZIPOP.1393.PP.1465011.3363, designated 2012-10-10), standing on a public street corner in Mokotow. The Wikipedia reproduction of the register carries an unusually complete 2012 survey measurement directly in its table: height 21m, girth 358cm, which is real dendrological data rather than a guess. No second source independent of that register/Wikipedia-list family was found this pass (no Wikimedia Commons photo, no dedicated writeup beyond the same register-family pages). Ships flagged per Step 2 as single-sourced. Age not documented; do not estimate one without a girth-based growth-rate source for Populus x canescens.
